steps: G2 REGEX-HOIST -- the PS 5.1 trap + the fix. CORRECT: build the endpoint programmatically ($rangeEnd = [char]0xFFFF), and replace with [regex]::Matches() + reverse-order manual Substring (no scriptblock), naming vars by $assignments.Count+1.
